use_case_summary: Enterprise RAG for legal/compliance discovery. Index firm documents (contracts, briefs, discovery PDFs) at 100M-300M scale. Query flow: query -> FAISS/IVF/HNSW approximate search -> top-k dense results -> cross-encoder rerank (legal fine-tuned). Must preserve provenance, link to source docs, and log each step for audits.
requirements: Index scale: target 250M documents (avg 2-4 pages per doc)
Embeddings: 1536-4096 dims, prefer open checkpoints; want batch embedding pipeline and incremental upserts
Reranking: cross-encoder stage to run on GPU with 95th pct latency < 350ms (per query end-to-end)
Throughput target: sustained 150-200 qps during peak, spiky bursts to 500 qps
Cost sensitivity: target cost per query (end-to-end) < $0.02 average at steady state
Retention: configurable per-tenant retention policies (30d default, some legal holds indefinitely)
Audit logging: immutable request/response logs, token-level tracing, exportable to SIEM
Data residency: index shards must remain in customer VPC / on-prem cluster
Auth: SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, role-based access control
KMS/HSM: key separation and envelope encryption for embeddings and index metadata
technical_targets: 95th percentile latency SLO: 300ms for simple queries; 500ms allowed for reranker-heavy workloads
P99 latency target for interactive UX: <1s
Index build window: daily incremental indexing; full reindex tolerable within maintenance window (48-72h)
Storage estimate: ~120TB raw + compressed vector store (quantized)
poc_plan: Phase 0: Security & architecture signoff (deliver SRA + KMS diagrams)
Phase 1: 1M document pilot in customer VPC (embeddings + retrieval + rerank) - 2 weeks

pricing_notes: Team prefers a committed capacity (Dedicated/Private) quote. Willing to consider multi-year for discount; require unit economics breakdown (token costs, GPU-hours, storage) and Optimize recommendations (quantization, batching) to justify commit.
sales_play: Position Redwood Private with Optimize add-on. Emphasize VPC delivery, audit logs, and legal-domain reranker examples. Offer short-term Dedicated trial for performance baseline before full on-prem package.
final_quote_notes: Estimated ARR tied to deployment mode: Dedicated pilot -> $150k, full Private rollout -> $220k-$320k ARR depending on retention/SLA add-ons. Need legal to approve DPA and security appendix.
